caption: We budgeted for one baby's worth of everything. Everything turned out to be double. Anyone else do the twin math wrong the first time?

slides.title:
How we spend
our R41 000
household income
Living in Knysna
slides.body:
Him 31, her 29
Married, newborn twins (3 months)
Jobs: Timber mill supervisor & tour guide, she's on reduced hours since the twins
Combined net: R41 000 p/m

slides.title: Bond repayment
slides.includes: 3 bed in Hornlee, bought a year before we knew there'd be two
slides.body: We picked this place for the spare room. We now use both spare rooms.

slides.title: Baby costs
slides.includes: Nappies, formula, two lots of everything, the clothes they've already grown out of
slides.body: We budgeted for one baby's worth of everything. Everything is double.

slides.title: Groceries
slides.includes: Big monthly shop, plus the pharmacy runs that never used to happen
slides.body: Still two adults eating, but the trolley doesn't know that anymore.

slides.title: Car instalment
slides.includes: Traded her hatchback for a 7-seater once we knew there were two car seats coming
slides.body: Neither of us wanted an SUV. Two capsules don't fit side by side in anything smaller.

slides.title: Medical aid
slides.includes: Family plan, upgraded the week we found out it was twins
slides.body: The jump on the payslip was smaller than the jump in appointments.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Petrol & insurance, electricity & water, phone & fibre, funeral policies, extra life cover, stokvel
slides.body: Thirteen thousand three hundred rand of things that all quietly grew the month they arrived.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R41 000 between us, with her hours down since the twins. Thinner than either of our old single budgets combined.

slides.title: We stopped assuming double meant simple double
slides.body:
We put both our statements into Beyond Horizon and finally saw the twins' costs against our own budget in one place.

The baby line alone was R4 200 — nearly double what friends with one baby had told us to expect.

No bank login needed.
